name: Shakespearean "winter of discontent" phrasing
description: Fires on the literary phrase "winter of discontent" and related winter/fury wording echoing the famous opening line.

name: Remarks about time, speed and efficiency
description: Fires on short statements about elapsed time, minutes and seconds, and being faster, quicker or more convenient.

name: Aphorisms on knowledge versus ignorance
description: Fires on maxim-style phrasings pairing knowledge and power with ignorance and bliss, e.g. "ignorance is bliss".

name: Bureaucratic and German efficiency phrasing
description: Fires on references to efficiency, especially of government offices and the trope of German efficiency.

name: "Gotta love" plus onion or ontology words
description: Fires on "gotta love" expressions alongside tokens like onion, French dip and ontology, as in praising an ontology debate.

name: "in-" prefixed words and the game Infamous
description: Fires on words beginning with in- (infamous, infographics, infrared, influencer) and on recommendations of the game Infamous.

name: Talk of efficiency and inefficiency
description: Fires on statements about caring (or not) about efficiency and inefficiency, often with the German-efficiency trope.

name: Getting straight to the point
description: Fires on phrasing about getting to the point and proceeding directly without preamble.

name: References to the ENTJ personality type
description: Fires on mentions of the MBTI type ENTJ and ENTJs, often with assertive markers like obviously and definitely.

name: Giving someone a chance or credit
description: Fires on phrases about giving a person or team a chance, a shot, or too much credit or importance.
